registration.title: Home advantage by competition
registration.what: Learn each competition's home advantage as the seasons go, shrunk hard towards the overall figure.
registration.why: Ten of 61 leagues were off by more than two standard errors, where chance gives about three.
registration.how: A running home-side error by competition with a two-year half-life.
registration.hypothesis: League-level home advantage improves the result probabilities.

expected.evidence: The final period had been looked at by earlier diagnostics, so this is strong historical evidence and not a blind test.

registration.success_criteria: The research round's bar (experiments/research_frame/REGISTER.md): better by 0.002 on the final period, the 99.6% interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing, better in 2024/25 and 2025/26, no goal market worse by 0.0005, and 60% of competitions no worse.

events.label: Selection window
events.meaningful: The figure the setting was chosen on.

events.label: Final period
events.meaningful: No. The interval crosses zero and under half the competitions are better.

events.reason: Too weak and unstable to predict with.
